messages.text: Draft a fictional weekly release summary for the Atlas export in Northstar Reports.
I will organize the verified fictional launch facts into a concise summary.
Start with the shipped change and reader impact, not the build chronology.
The opening now states what shipped and why it matters before the supporting detail.
Keep the tone plain and avoid unsupported superlatives.
The revision uses neutral language and only the supplied fictional facts.
Use three short evidence bullets after the opening.
The three evidence bullets now follow the change-and-impact lead.
Understood: future release summaries should lead with change and impact before detail.
